failures_and_corrections.issue: Parent texture aliases were initially checked before merging the child texture override.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Resolve inherited geometry and final child slots before checking faces. Source assets unchanged.

failures_and_corrections.issue: Metadata helper extraction included a UI compatibility wrapper without its UI dependencies (E0433/E0425).
failures_and_corrections.correction: Compile the unmodified pure production format helpers only; Game/renderer code is not stubbed or claimed executed.

failures_and_corrections.issue: Windows ZipInfo normalized the malicious backslash fixture into a legal name before testing.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Preserve raw malicious names in fixtures and reject orig_filename/filename mismatches, including NUL truncation, in the archive reader. No weakened assertions; resource-pack bytes unchanged by this correction.
failures_and_corrections.first_windows_native_checks: NOT RUN because safety tests failed

failures_and_corrections.issue: World-model closure initially omitted canonical models referenced by leaf items.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Retain 14 supplied canonical models and two supplied shared cropped-texture parents. Add native item baking/UV checks and rerun both platforms.
